Elena: Heads-up — spotted a broken citation toolbar link on /docs/reference/toolbar.md (anchor -> /docs/console/toolbar/overview returns 404). Can someone quick-fix? small frontmatter/toc tweak likely. @Sam any bandwidth? :eyes:
Sam: I can take a look, will open a tiny PR if it's just anchors. Is /docs/console/toolbar the canonical path now or did we move it again? @Maya or @Elena know for sure?
docbot: link-checker: 1 failing link detected in /docs/reference/toolbar.md -> /docs/console/toolbar/overview (404). Suggested replacement: /docs/console/toolbar (no /overview).
Maya: That sounds right — we collapsed the overview page last quarter. If it's a one-line frontmatter/toc fix I can patch today. I'll run local link-check: `npm run docs:linkcheck ./docs/reference/toolbar.md` and report back.
Elena: Prefer Sam opens the PR so we keep the repo history consistent; Maya can review the content change. @Alex can you do the code review when it's ready?
Alex: I can review after lunch, ETA ~15:00 PT. If Maya volunteers to review content now, I'll queue CR then. :thumbsup:
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2456 — updates anchor, fixes a bad example snippet. Included a quick `sed` note in the PR description for maintainers: `perl -0777 -pe "s#/docs/console/toolbar/overview#/docs/console/toolbar#g" -i docs/reference/toolbar.md` (tested locally).
Maya: LGTM overall. Small nit: the example code block lost language hint, I pushed a tiny commit to the PR to add ```bash to the snippet so syntax highlighting renders. Also re-ran link-check locally: passes.
Elena: Thanks — two quick asks before merge: add `docs:owner: elena` to the frontmatter (so the ownership sweep picks it up) and add the path to `docs/tests/quick_links.txt` so our CI quick-scan covers it.
Sam: Done — frontmatter updated and path appended to tests/quick_links.txt. Local link-check and `npm test:docs-quick` both pass. Will wait for Alex CR.
Alex: Reviewed & approved the PR, small comment resolved. Merged. :shipit:
docbot: link-checker: re-scan complete for /docs/reference/toolbar.md — 0 failing links. scan_id: 2026-03-18-7
